title: Lamb and Pilaf Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful syrian dish made with lamb and pilaf, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the pilaf to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Return the lamb to the pan and stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Season with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and cook for 30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
